claim: Exactly-once delivery guarantee
scope: Not claimed in v1.1. Zen Mesh provides at-least-once with idempotency, not exactly-once.

claim: Zero event loss under all failure conditions
scope: Not claimed in v1.1. Delivery guarantees documented per delivery topology with explicit DLQ for non-delivery.

claim: Per-source ordering or causal ordering guarantees
scope: Not claimed in v1.1. No ordering guarantee provided.

claim: Single-settle delivery semantics
scope: Explicitly excluded in v1.1. Conformance fixtures validate rejection of single-settle claims.

claim: All runtime paths are proven
scope: Not claimed in v1.1. Victory-locked proofs are scenario-specific. General at-least-once, failover autonomy, and disconnected operation remain unproven.

claim: Production-live security validation (positive-path SSRF, live provider E2E)
scope: Deferred to restricted_live evidence level per supersession contract §4.2.

claim: Bounded latency SLA
scope: Not claimed in v1.1. Latency measured and recorded per delivery topology but no formal SLA offered.

claim: NodePort or port-forward based delivery
scope: Explicitly excluded. All delivery uses egress-to-public-target architecture. NodePort/port-forward prohibited.

claim: BFF processes payload content in delivery path
scope: Explicitly excluded. BFF is not in payload path in any delivery topology.

claim: Header spoofing prevention for all header types
scope: Not claimed. Specific header controls are validated; general header spoofing prevention is not claimed.

claim: Provider SLA uptime or availability guarantees
scope: Not claimed in v1.1. Provider availability is the provider's responsibility.

claim: General at-least-once guarantee across all delivery paths
scope: Not claimed. At-least-once is proven per topology path with scenario-specific evidence.

claim: Production deployment or broad customer operation
scope: Not claimed in v1.1. No production deployment proof exists; frozen-green baselines are sandbox qualification evidence only.
source: EVIDENCE-V11-001 baseline refresh; L1/L2/Traffic freeze scope records

claim: Restricted-live or cloud-proven operation (including same-RC restricted-live)
scope: Not claimed in v1.1. Restricted-live/cloud qualification is future work; absent evidence means UNKNOWN or NOT_PROVEN, never inferred PASS.

claim: Any compliance, certification, or attestation status (FedRAMP, SOC 2, PCI, HIPAA, ISO, ICP)
scope: Not claimed. Zen Mesh makes no compliance or certification claim of any kind; such status would require explicit separate evidence.

claim: Complete sovereign-operation evidence (full DR, destructive recovery, offline signed verification completion)
scope: Not claimed in v1.1. Sovereignty evidence is claim-by-claim; unproven claims remain explicitly NOT_PROVEN (see zen-mgmt sovereignty evidence bundle).
source: EVIDENCE-V11-001 baseline refresh; zen-mgmt generated SOVEREIGNTY_EVIDENCE

claim: Complete provider parity
scope: Not claimed in v1.1. Provider status is enumerated per provider (e.g., Twilio downstream form-urlencoded routing is PARTIAL); unlisted providers are not claimed.
source: EVIDENCE-V11-001 baseline refresh; provider registry evidence

claim: Final MCP RO/RW convergence and object-level MCP permission completion
scope: Not claimed in v1.1. MCP surface is implementation-present; final permission convergence remains open work.

claim: Full Pipelines V1
scope: Not claimed in v1.1. Pipelines/Compiler-IR verticals are implementation-present lanes, not frozen or fully proven.

claim: Customer-facing DLQ API authorization
scope: Not claimed. No public customer-facing DLQ API surface exists; durable-DLQ terminal-state semantics are internal qualification evidence only.

claim: Arbitrary topology equivalence for Traffic HA/durability results
scope: Not claimed. Traffic frozen-baseline results are bounded to the declared qualified topology; other topologies are not claimed equivalent.
